name: Atraxa, Praetors' Voice
oracle_text:
Flying, vigilance, deathtouch, lifelink
At the beginning of your end step, proliferate. (Choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there.)
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of your end step, proliferate. (Choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there.)

needs.what: a full 701.27a proliferate: the controller chooses any number of permanents (any controller) and/or players that have counters, then each chosen one gets one more counter of each kind already on it -- including player counters such as poison (Player.poison) on opponents, and -1/-1 or other counters on opponents' permanents
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `proliferate` op (ops_combat_flags.py) takes only `objects` and mechanically adds a counter of every kind to every permanent the selector matches (default: permanents you control). It never touches players, so an opponent's poison counters cannot be proliferated, and it offers no choice, so widening `objects` to all permanents would force-grow opponents' planeswalker loyalty and other counters the player would decline. Either selector choice diverges from the printed 'choose any number of permanents and/or players'.
